posts.author: @CryptoKing_99
posts.text: WOW! 🚀 Elon just dropped a secret coin! Send 1 ETH to this wallet and get 10 back instantly! [LINK]

posts.author: @CityWeatherNow
posts.text: Severe thunderstorm warning issued for the downtown area starting at 4 PM. Please secure outdoor items.

posts.author: @HealthGuru_Real
posts.text: Doctors are hiding this! Drinking a glass of bleach cures all viruses within 24 hours. #Truth
posts.feedback_text: Dangerous medical misinformation. Always verify health claims with official sources.

posts.author: @LocalLibrary
posts.text: Reminder: The summer reading program starts next Monday! Sign up at the front desk.
posts.feedback_text: Correct. This is a harmless, verified community post.

posts.author: @NewsAlertBot_88
posts.text: BREAKING: The Eiffel Tower just collapsed in a massive earthquake! Look at these photos! [LINK]
posts.feedback_text: Sensationalist fake news bot. Major events will be covered by multiple reputable news outlets.

posts.author: @GamerDad99
posts.text: Anyone know how to fix a stick drift issue on a standard controller? Driving me crazy.
posts.feedback_text: Good call. Just a normal user asking a mundane question.

posts.author: @OfficialGov_Update
posts.text: Your tax refund is pending. Click here to enter your social security number to claim it immediately: gov-tax-refund.net
posts.feedback_text: Phishing scam! Real government agencies do not ask for social security numbers via social media links.

posts.author: @CityTransit
posts.text: The Blue Line train will experience 15-minute delays today due to track maintenance.

level_2_posts.author: @IronAlpha_Fitness
level_2_posts.text: Finally broke the plateau! Pulled 400kg like it was empty. If your squat isn't at least 100kg by month two, you're not training, you're playing. Buy my supplement stack! [LINK]
level_2_posts.feedback_text: AI Generated. Look at the barbell morphing into his hand and the bending physics. Classic engagement bait to sell fake supplements.

level_2_posts.author: @EarthRebellion
level_2_posts.text: MILLIONS took to the streets today! The media is hiding this massive climate strike! SHARE to show they can't silence us! 🌍✊
level_2_posts.feedback_text: AI Generated. Check the background signs—they turn into gibberish ('BHO FECH MENY'). A tactic to manufacture artificial outrage.

level_2_posts.author: @StormChaser_EU
level_2_posts.text: Absolutely terrifying F5 tornado dropping right in the middle of Paris! Unprecedented! Why isn't the government sounding the alarms?!
level_2_posts.feedback_text: AI Generated. Supercells don't form this cleanly over dense urban heat islands. The lighting on the buildings also doesn't match the storm.

level_2_posts.author: @LodzMeteo_Official
level_2_posts.text: After comparing the latest GFS and ECMWF models, we are looking at a mild evening across the Voivodeship. Expect scattered showers around 18:00.
level_2_posts.feedback_text: Correct. Real, verified public service announcement based on actual meteorological data.

level_2_posts.author: @CommunityGreenThumb
level_2_posts.text: The volunteer team did an amazing job with the community pollinator garden this weekend! Stop by and see the echinacea in bloom.
level_2_posts.feedback_text: Correct. Real photo. Harmless community engagement post with no AI artifacts.

level_3_posts.author: @TheDailySatire
level_3_posts.text: City Council announces new initiative to combat obesity: All sidewalks downtown are now mandatory scooter-only zones. Walking is now a finable offense.
level_3_posts.feedback_text: Satire. It is meant as a joke, but users are taking it seriously and getting angry. Approving it drives massive engagement but hurts platform trust.

level_3_posts.author: @HousingAdvocate
level_3_posts.text: Tech companies are deliberately making the housing crisis worse by overpaying remote workers. They are ruining our local economy and should be taxed at 90%.
level_3_posts.feedback_text: Free Speech. This is a highly biased, aggressive opinion, but an opinion is not 'fake news'. Rejecting it suppresses legitimate political speech.

level_3_posts.author: @CrimeWatch_Local
level_3_posts.text: Violent crime in the city has skyrocketed by 500% in just one month! We are living in an absolute warzone! Protect your families!
level_3_posts.feedback_text: Misleading Context. The '500%' increase was from 1 minor incident to 5 incidents on a single street. True statistic, but highly manipulative framing.

level_3_posts.author: @MunicipalGov_Portal
level_3_posts.text: The City Council meeting minutes for October 12th have been uploaded. Topics include minor zoning adjustments and water management plans.
level_3_posts.feedback_text: Civic Truth. It is entirely factual and important, but incredibly boring. Approving this protects your Truth score, but your Engagement will drop.

level_3_posts.author: @EcoCorp_Global
level_3_posts.text: We are proud to announce our new eco-friendly data centers! By purchasing carbon offsets, we have completely erased our environmental footprint! 🌿
level_3_posts.feedback_text: Greenwashing. Corporate PR that technically lies. Buying offsets does not 'erase' a footprint. Moderating corporate sponsors is a tough call.

level_3_posts.author: @Whistleblower_99
level_3_posts.text: LEAKED DOCS: The new highway project was pushed through without a mandatory environmental impact study. The safety committee was completely bypassed.
level_3_posts.feedback_text: Genuine Leak. Highly controversial and damaging to powerful people, but entirely true. Approving this is risky but essential for the truth.
